offences.quote: Students must never use Generative AI tools to produce content that is presented as their own critical thinking or original creation, whether for assessment or formative work.

Where the University suspects that Generative AI has been used to create assessment content without acknowledgement or authorisation, it reserves the right to invoke formal processes of investigation.
